nusmp.skill.book_demon_beast.description: The grimoire of Demon Beast Magic, a sinister beast magic that calls the claws, fangs and voices of chimeras and hydras out of the underworld. Twelve pages: claw, quill and spirit-beast strikes; Chimera's Roar, a fang lunge, a terror howl and a horned rush; a hunting ground that rakes everything inside it; a mantle and a hide for yourself; Hydra's Many Heads; and the daily Hydra's Regrowth. Its hits make foes bleed, poison them, shred their defence and drive them mad with fear. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_beast.descrip: Grimoire magic: Demon Beast Magic, chimera and hydra beasts that claw, bite, roar and regrow. Its twelve pages cover claws and quills, a roaring cone, a fang lunge, terror, a horned charge, a hunting ground, a beast mantle and hide, the three-headed hydra and the daily regrowth. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_beast_: A spirit beast of the underworld lunges out of the grimoire in the shape of a black-violet bolt. Deals 8 damage (scaled by EP) to everything in its path, up to about 22 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_claw: The chimera's paw has no patience for distance. Three claw swipes land in quick succession on one target within 5 blocks, 4 damage each (scaled by EP), and the third leaves a wound that bleeds for 5 s (1.5 damage every half second and a little magicule drain).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_porcup: The demon porcupine bristles and the air fills with quills. Fires a fan of 7 stingers (about 20 blocks), each dealing 3 damage (scaled by EP) and poisoning the target for 4 s; a target pierced by three or more quills also starts to bleed for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimeras_roa: Two magic circles open behind you and the horned head of a lion forms around your outstretched arm, then it roars. Blasts a cone up to 11 blocks long for 10 damage (scaled by EP) on up to 12 foes, throws them back, makes them cower (Fear, 5 s), weakens them (Weakness, 5 s) and tears their defence (Fragility, 5 s).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_fang: The chimera pounces before its prey can blink. You leap to a target up to 14 blocks away and bite for 11 damage (scaled by EP); it is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s), loses defence (Fragility, 5 s) and bleeds for 5 s, and the bite heals you a little.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.terror_howl: A howl that comes from somewhere below the world. Everything within 9 blocks, up to 16 foes, is gripped by Fear (up to 5 s, shorter on players and bosses), forgets its target, glows for 6 s, takes 3 damage (scaled by EP) and is shoved away. Hard control: shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.horned_spiri: A horned spirit beast charges through you and leaves the ground behind. Dashes up to 10 blocks hitting everything on the way for 9 damage (scaled by EP), knocking them back and up and slowing them for 1.5 s; you gain Resistance II for 3 s and Speed II for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_hunt: The chimera marks its territory, and what is inside is prey. A hunting ground of 7 blocks opens at the aim point for 7 s: every half second enemies inside take 2.5 damage (scaled by EP, up to 10 of them), are slowed (Slowness II) and kept bleeding, and are frightened by the first pulse.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_beast_: The beast aura settles over you like a second skin. For 30 s you gain Strength II, Speed I and Jump Boost II, and your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by EP).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.underworld_h: Scales and hide, thick as a hydra's. For 15 s you gain Absorption (the level grows with your EP), Resistance II and thorns: anyone who strikes you takes 2 damage back.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.hydras_many_: The hydra of the underworld lends you its heads. For 5 s three spectral heads circle you and strike the three nearest foes within 12 blocks every half second, 5 damage each (scaled by EP): the first head poisons (Poison II, 3 s) and heals you a little, the second slows and weakens, the third opens a bleeding wound. Signature page.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.hydras_regro: Two magic circles open and the flesh closes by itself, even where a limb was lost. Heals up to 40% of your maximum health at once (the usual healing decay applies), gives Regeneration II for 8 s and washes out poison, wither, weakness, slowness, blindness, bleeding and fire. It cannot be cast while your magic currents are severed (Magic Jamming). Daily page: 3 minute cooldown.
